extension.news: v1:1.1.0-1 (2026-11-22): Fork of JellyCon 1.1.0 (twiebe) ------------------------------- + Show server errors to the user and let them resolve rejected logins + Don't keep Kodi from exiting: faster service stop + Settings converted to settings format version 1 + Short help text for every visible setting + Context menu works again when Kodi started before the user logged in + A user switch is picked up right away, without restarting Kodi + Optionally save the password, so JellyCon signs in again by itself after the user was disabled + Playback, stop and the context menu react faster, background work no longer holds up the player + Resume starts at the resume point right away, without a second seek + Movie and show lists carry runtime, resolution, HDR, codec, audio channels and episode counts like the library, for skins that show them (Nightcity 0.4.94) + A list is named after the menu entry that opened it + Kodi no longer crashes when Back is pressed twice quickly while a list loads; cached lists are checked against the server by the service + Artwork width per kind (posters, fanart, thumbs, logos ...) that fits the GUI, under Artwork size in the settings: smaller images load faster and take less memory on small devices + Loading the cast when the information opens can be switched off; skins that show cast and crew from TMDb, like Nightcity 0.4.96, switch it off for themselves

extension.description:
Welcome to Jellyfin for Kodi! A whole new way to manage and view your media library. The Jellyfin addon for Kodi combines the best of Kodi - ultra smooth navigation, beautiful UIs and playback of any file under the sun, and Jellyfin - the most powerful fully open source multi-client media metadata indexer and server.
Jellyfin for Kodi is the absolute best way to enjoy the incredible Kodi playback engine combined with the power of Jellyfin's centralized database. Features: * Direct integration with the Kodi library for native Kodi speed * Instant synchronization with the Jellyfin server * Full support for Movie, TV and Music collections * Jellyfin Server direct stream and transcoding support - use Kodi when you are away from home!
extension.news: v1:2.2.0-14 (2026-11-21): Fork of jellyfin-kodi 2.2.0 (twiebe) ------------------------------------ + Update sync only writes the items that changed, fetched in parallel + Don't wipe the library when fetching its items fails + Don't sync a library twice after an interrupted sync + Page size setting is no longer silently limited to 50 + Faster sync: shared exit monitor, artwork settings read once, cached row class + Don't keep Kodi from exiting with the websocket, service restart works again + Roll back database changes when an error is raised + Keep the saved login when the server answers with an error + Close the progress dialog when a sync fails + Notify about new items after the first notification too + Honour the server offline notification setting + Keep the server's tracks when the transcode track dialog is disabled + Treat 0 days in next episodes as no limit again + Remove the enhanced artwork setting + Short help text for every visible setting + Add to playlist in the Jellyfin options of movies, episodes, music videos and songs + A stop no longer holds up other add-ons for 3 seconds (a skin's return to the info page) + Playback starts faster, the skip button and dialogs no longer hold up other add-ons + The stop position is reported to the second, not up to 10 seconds old + The skip button closes when seeking back before the segment + Optionally save the password, so jellyfin-kodi signs in again by itself after the user was disabled + "Update password" no longer stops library updates until Kodi restarts + A queue started shortly after a stop is no longer emptied, the whole album plays + A stopped queue is cleared right at the stop, not 3 seconds later + No second reload of the lists after a title played here: Kodi has done it already + A click on a title in a playlist or dynamic view opens its info page when select shows information (Nightcity), a track plays + "Play from here" and "Play" on a playlist, series or season no longer fail with a KeyError + A stop right after the start no longer leaves a refused stop report that repeats at every later start + A deleted title leaves the Kodi library at once, not when the server reports it 30 seconds later + Library changes from the server reach Kodi in about 1 second instead of 5 to 6 + Artwork width per kind (posters, stills, backdrops, logos), Auto fits the GUI resolution; replaces max artwork resolution and compress artwork + Changed artwork sizes apply to the library at once, no repair needed + The backdrop width setting is called fanart width, as in Kodi + Lists and widgets show changed artwork sizes at once, not only after a restart + A sync without changes writes next to nothing to the disk, sparing the flash memory of small devices: settings, library nodes and sync state are only saved when they change + The update sync skips unchanged music, as it does for movies and shows + An artist's discography no longer gains duplicate albums with every music sync; existing duplicates are removed

version 1:3.12.6-3 (fork of 3.12.6 by twiebe): Faster - A full sync writes about 40% less to the disk than upstream, which spares the flash memory of small devices: plex.db is no longer rewritten, and its copy for the sync is written once instead of twice

version 1:3.12.6-1 (fork of 3.12.6 by twiebe): Sync you can rely on - A failed or slow answer of the PMS no longer hangs the sync, the other libraries sync on (upstream #2087, #1832, #1967) - An error in the background sync no longer stops PKC from syncing until Kodi restarts (upstream #2069) - Nothing is deleted from Kodi unless the PMS confirms it is gone: an incomplete answer of the PMS used to remove whole libraries - Short database transactions that let Kodi write in between: no more "database is locked", fewer stutters during background syncs (upstream #1929, #1471) - Renamed or replaced files reach Kodi with the next sync, with direct paths (upstream #1893, #2201, #1871) - Collections and labels reach Kodi with the next sync, without a repair (upstream #2141, #2095, #689) - Items removed from Kodi's library come back with the next sync - New shows, seasons, albums and tracks from the background sync no longer keep Kodi waiting for the PMS - A track without an album gets an album of its own instead of failing - Suspending PKC stops a running sync at once Faster - Metadata is asked for 20 items at a time: a repair sync of a large library is almost three times as fast - Each full sync writes only what changed instead of every item again - The background sync writes new items in batches - A collection's details are downloaded once per sync, not once per movie in it Fixed - Plex user ratings reach Kodi - The sync no longer deletes bookmarks you set in Kodi - Changed settings apply without restarting Kodi Settings - Artwork width per kind (poster, still, fanart, banner) that fits the screen, instead of 1920 px for everything - A short help text for every visible setting - "Verify access to media files" works, off unless you turn it on - "Prefer Kodi collection art" works the right way round - "Verify Host SSL Certificate" really verifies the certificate, also in plugin calls - Eight settings that did nothing are gone
